FR-001.title: Setup wizard MUST present its settings as a single screen with a tab strip

FR-002.title: Each tab groups logically related settings; no 1-2-setting tabs

FR-003.title: Tabs navigable both by direct click and by Next

FR-004.title: Next MUST NOT advance past a tab whose own required fields fail validation

FR-005.title: Last tab MUST be a review tab displaying every value read-only

FR-006.title: Review tab MUST display queued roles/accounts as bordered list boxes

FR-007.title: Every list box anywhere in the app MUST be a bordered list (app-wide convention)

FR-008.title: Finish MUST validate all tabs and create queued items together in one submission

FR-009.title: Committee roles added one at a time via a + control

FR-010.title: Added roles shown in a bordered list box, removable before finishing

FR-012.title: Chart of Accounts tab offers the same fields as the standalone add-account control

FR-013.title: Queued account held in wizard state, not created until Finish

FR-014.title: Duplicate account name (queued or persisted) rejected same as standalone page

FR-015.title: Adding an account is optional, never blocks finishing setup

FR-016.title: Add-account fields/validation are a single shared experience (immediate vs deferred)

FR-017.title: Opening Balances tab covers every eligible existing + queued account

FR-018.title: Opening balance entries deferred, posted together at Finish

FR-019.title: Opening-balance experience is shared: immediate-post on the standalone page, deferred on the wizard tab

FR-020.title: Opening Balances tab stays in sync with Chart of Accounts tab additions/removals

FR-022.title: Theme is a dropdown selector, applies immediately

FR-023.title: Every other yes/no setting is a checkbox, not a toggle switch

FR-024.title: Regrouping into tabs preserves every field, rule, and default

FR-026.title: Debug seeder must include opening balances for the accounts it seeds

FR-021.title: Finish blocked unless opening balances posted or sample data selected

FR-025.title: Sample-data checkbox is debug-build-only and lives on the review tab

context: constraint: reuse the Tabs/Tab BlazorBootstrap component already used by FinancePage.razor
constraint: RadzenDataGrid for tabular data per CLAUDE.md data-grid standards
constraint: no @code blocks — every .razor pairs with a .razor.cs
constraint: Fee/Payment/Transaction/JournalEntry are immutable and financially exempt from soft-delete; opening balances post as one ACID GL transaction with a balancing Opening Balance Equity plug
intent: Replace the setup wizard's linear five-step flow with a single tabbed screen, logically regrouped, that also lets coordinators queue committee roles, Chart of Accounts entries, and opening balances (all bordered list boxes, an app-wide convention) and review everything before finishing — opening balances are mandatory unless sample data is loaded instead.
expectations: Settings page's own General tab (post-setup theme toggle) is unchanged — only the /setup wizard is in scope
No change to what data first-run setup captures, validates, or defaults — only how it's grouped/entered
approach: Extract the standalone Chart of Accounts add-account form and the standalone Opening Balances entry table into shared, callback-driven components; the setup wizard rebuilds on the Finance-screen Tabs/Tab component, feeding those shared components a queuing callback instead of the standalone pages' immediate-persist callback, and SetupService composes IAccountService/IOpeningBalanceService at Finish so everything is created together.

decisions.decision: Reuse the Tabs/Tab BlazorBootstrap component from FinancePage.razor
decisions.why: issue explicitly references the Finance screen tabs; already proven in this codebase

decisions.decision: Shared AddAccountForm/OpeningBalanceEntryForm take an OnSubmit callback, no internal mode flag
decisions.why: keeps persistence knowledge out of the shared component (Dependency Inversion); standalone pages keep immediate-create/post unchanged, wizard queues instead
decisions.rejected: an internal Immediate/Deferred enum branching inside the shared component

decisions.decision: SetupRequest/SetupService.InitializeAsync compose IAccountService and IOpeningBalanceService directly
decisions.why: neither service depends on a Settings record existing, so Finish stays one service call, matching how CommitteeOfficeHolderTitles already works
decisions.rejected: UI layer calling AccountService/OpeningBalanceService itself after SetupService.InitializeAsync returns

decisions.decision: BorderedListBox is one generic shared component, not a CSS class applied four times
decisions.why: FR-007 requires one true application-wide convention; a shared component guarantees it in code including overflow/scroll handling
decisions.rejected: a shared .bordered-list-box CSS class applied independently in each of the four places

decisions.decision: Debug seeder posts an explicit OpeningBalance entry for its seeded accounts, before its historical-transaction simulation
decisions.why: FR-026 requires seeded accounts to have opening balances specifically; todays seeder only reaches balances via simulated years of transactions with no OpeningBalance journal entry
decisions.rejected: leaving the seeder unchanged and relying on simulated history alone
